content.comment_body: I purchased the PC/USB cable ([article_no]). When I connected it to my laptop running Windows 7 Ultimate 32-bit, I encountered a 'driver not found' issue. I would appreciate help resolving this problem. Thank you to everyone!

Hello, Please check this: demo software, upgrades/updates, drivers. Typically, you’re prompted to install the USB driver during [product_name] installation. If you skip that, you will need to install the driver manually later. Regards,

Hi, It seems there might have been a mistake. According to the Product Information Sheet, the process is: 1. Plug the cable into [product_name]. 2. Install the driver. 3. Connect the cable to your PC. Make sure you have the correct [product_name] software version that supports Windows 7 ([version_no]). Try searching the forum for instructions regarding [product_name] USB. Hope this helps.
Hi, Which software version are you using? As other users mentioned, it could be a version issue or something missed during [product_name] software installation. Best regards,
You should install the cable’s driver software.

Thank you everyone! I resolved the issue by using a laptop with Windows XP. However, when connecting my laptop to [product_name] [article_no] via PC/USB cable, the upload button in [product_name] software ([version_no]) is disabled, even though [product_name] is in stop mode. I want to upload the program from [product_name], but I am unable to do so.
Hey, Are you able to download from PC to PLC, or is that disabled too? Is your software a demo version, or have you tried reinstalling? Best regards,

Hello [user_name], Have you installed demo software provided by [user_name]? [user_name] mentioned: RESTRICTION: You cannot transfer (download or upload) circuit programs to/from [product_name] via a programming cable in the demo version. Online monitoring and program testing are only available in the full version of the software.

Hello! I installed the full version of the software. When I try to upload a program from my [product_name], a notification appears in the attached image, even though I’ve selected the correct interface.
Sorry [user_name], I have now attached the pictures.
Sorry [user_name], I don’t have access to my PC right now. Can you send the images as jpg files?
Have you selected a new interface? Did you change your COM port? On Windows, you can check the COM port in device manager, then select the same COM port in [product_name] software. Best regards,
Hello, It’s difficult to determine from your image—please post the Info window message (Tools > Info window [F4]). Which version of Windows 7 are you using: 32-bit or 64-bit? Regards,
I use Windows XP SP2, running on a virtual machine (VMWare Workstation). The program in [product_name] is password-protected, but I lost the password. Could these be the causes?
Hello [user_name], Have you tried using CTRL+H to select the appropriate [product_name]?
Why are you using a virtual machine? Is there a reason you can't install directly on your laptop? This could be contributing to the problem.
New question has been moved to 'Error when downloading program to newer [product_name]'. With best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion highlights frequent difficulties with driver installation and software interactions for [company_name] [product_name] USB programming cables across different Windows environments. Users experience confusion navigating unclear driver prompts, demo versus full software restrictions, disabled upload functions, and inconsistent system feedback. These challenges indicate a need for improved documentation, clearer setup instructions, and better support for troubleshooting within the software environment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate straightforward driver setup and seamless communication between PC and [product_name], including reliable program uploads through the supplied software. They expect clear guidance and consistent software functions without unexpected limitations or ambiguous errors.
